recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to these extension definitions should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than in retired core spreadsheet rows.
issue_request: FHIR-35835 was a Published FHIR-core/Patient Administration change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking that listed contactpoint and iso21090 extensions support the new ExtendedContactDetail datatype.
initial_application: Commit b759378e9a applied the issue in core by adding ExtendedContactDetail to iso21090-preferred and contactpoint-comment contexts; the Jira application comment narrowed the direct updates to those two extensions because the phone-related extensions apply through ExtendedContactDetail.telecom's ContactPoint.
additional_context: PA WGM minutes confirm the persuasive vote and link the issue to FHIR-31615. Commit dd468d4f17 later removed extension rows from the R5 core source, and the active definitions now live in the FHIR Extension Pack. Later preferred-extension deprecation guidance does not remove the ExtendedContactDetail context.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit documenting that the current source state is correct and that re-editing core would duplicate or reintroduce extension definitions now maintained outside the core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Preferred-method-of-contact request resolved no-change because FHIR-35835 allowed iso21090-preferred on ExtendedContactDetail.
Earlier preferred-extension context work established Address and ContactPoint before FHIR-35835 added ExtendedContactDetail; already represented on the combined branch.
Later deprecated/retired iso21090-preferred in favor of rank without changing the ExtendedContactDetail context.
Later preferred/rank deprecation guidance is related but does not require a core source change for FHIR-35835.
